# The async phishing entry point still documents a synchronous Boolean return

The actor-based analyzeMessage method is async and its caller awaits its result, but the JSDoc still declares boolean. Document Promise<boolean> for this parent-side entry point and state that the resolved Boolean requests a warning after the actor query. Keep analyzeMessageBody's synchronous Boolean contract separate. This is an exact documentation/caller mismatch; no phishing or process test ran.

Scope: Phishing detector async API documentation.
